title: Leadership radar — 1:1 & exec sync agenda digest (scratch)
content:
Purpose: quick, skimmable prep for a string of leadership touchpoints this week — 1:1s with CEO/CTO/CFO + weekly exec staff sync. This is a working scratchpad: bullets, asks, and immediate follow-ups.

Top objectives (what I want to land across meetings):
- Confirm rollout/fallback policy for dedicated capacity in EU region (SLA language + contingency). Priority 1.
- Get alignment on temporary cost-smoothing for a large customer pilot (need CFO buy-in for a 90-day credit cap). Priority 2.
- Remove blocker on telemetry retention changes for payment/usage traces (SRE + compliance sign-off). Priority 2.
- Seed two quick-win product experiments for Optimize suggestions into Q2 roadmap (need eng commitment). Priority 3.

Data to have ready (one-pagers / 2 slides max):
- Latency trend (30/90 day) for hosted-api: p50/p95/p99 + brief note on root cause for recent p95 spike.
- Unit cost delta table: quantized model vs baseline for top-3 workloads (tokens/second, GPU-hours, estimated $/100k tokens).
- Customer impact timeline: incident -> mitigation -> residual risk for the EU dedicated customer pilot.

Agenda: 1:1s (15 min each)
- CEO (15m):
  - 3-min update: metrics + big ask (rollout contingency + customer credit).
  - Decision ask: greenlight short-term credit (yes/no) + authorize talking points for customer comms.
  - FYI: hiring ask for infra head (talent vs urgent backlog).
  - Notes to self: keep it high level, be explicit about risk tolerance and PR exposure.

- CTO (15m):
  - Technical ask: confirm SRE timeline for telemetry retention change (can we ship gating config by 3/20?).
  - Operational: discuss fallback routing for EU dedicated -> hosted fallback policy, how transparent to customers.
  - Resource ask: need +0.4 FTE SWE on serving-runtime for 6 weeks to unblock kernel swap experiment.
  - Technical bullets to bring: KV-cache regression possibility, perf test run ids (ENG-2743), canary plan.

- CFO (15m):
  - Ask: authorization for 90-day credit cap for pilot customer; numbers: $X estimated revenue risk vs retention benefit.
  - Present: simple cost vs retention case: 1) incremental cost of dedicated pool for pilot, 2) expected extension value.
  - Quick ask: sign-off on non-standard billing terms (legal will produce final doc).

Exec staff sync (30m):
- Quick updates (round robin, 2 min each): incidents, hiring highlights, major sales/customer asks.
- Focus topic (12 min): EU dedicated pilot status + fallback SLA decision (recommendation: staged rollback with hosted fallback + transparent customer SLA).
- Ops ask (8 min): telemetry retention change + rollout checklist (SRE + security).
- Wrap (2 min): call out follow-ups and owners.

Talking points & scripts (short):
- For customer credit narrative (CEO/CFO): "We want to remove friction while we validate the dedicated configuration. We'll provide a capped credit for the pilot period tied to latency SLO attainment and a mutually-agreed rollback clause."
- For CTO/Eng: "We need a short-term, low-risk kernel experiment deployed behind canary routing — if p95 regresses we flip the canary and notify stakeholders."

Open risks / unresolved questions:
- Risk: if fallback to hosted increases token cost materially, do we pass cost to customer or absorb? (CFO decision)
- Legal: non-standard billing terms need 48h review for pilot.
- SRE: telemetry retention change could temporarily blind debugging for a set of traces—need bridging logs.
- People: hiring timeline for infra lead looks 8–12 weeks; need workaround plan.

Parking lot (defer to next week unless urgent):
- Long-term billing model changes (tiered base fees).
- Dedicated autoscaling policy knob design doc (deeper dive with product-dedicated).

Post-meeting follow-ups (quick table — owner -> action -> due):
- Maya Patel -> Draft customer-facing pilot credit terms (incl rollback) -> due 2026-03-15.
- Roberto Kim -> Run perf retest for kernel swap and post canary plan -> due 2026-03-18.
- SRE lead (cc: N. Zhou) -> Telemetry retention migration runbook + bridging logs -> due 2026-03-17.
- Legal (L. Ortiz) -> Review non-standard billing terms -> due 2026-03-14.
- Me (Avery) -> Send meeting recap + owners/next steps within 24h of each touchpoint.

Notes to self / style reminders: keep asks crisp (yes/no where possible), default to preserving customer continuity, avoid deep technical minutiae in CEO/CFO 1:1s. Use the exec sync to surface blockers not to resolve them.

Quick checklist before each meeting (tickbox list in my head):
- Slide(s) exported to PDF and attached to calendar event.
- JIRA links and test ids included in notes.
- One-sentence decision ask at top of each slide.
- Pre-alert any key collaborator 30–60m before meeting if we need their live availability.

Version notes: this is a living scratchpad — will convert to a trimmed 1-slide pre-read for exec sync if CEO asks.

End of doc.
